definitionOfRound: One bounded real native/demo scope with its own exact-SHA CI and Git evidence, including repair; not one isolated test.

coreAndGovernance.doneWhen: Selected multi-Function Element version and validation metadata plus executable constraint/collaboration references have positive/negative native proof and independent reviewer qualifications; avoid invented SAP approval

coreAndGovernance.theme: Public Function ABI, evidence/compatibility, and Element-owned state
coreAndGovernance.doneWhen: All applicable public Function categories have checked contracts, typed UNKNOWN/Evidence, negative compatibility obligations, and selected domain-owned state behavior on native SDK

coreAndGovernance.theme: Target applicability and selected-implementation qualification (CORE-014 UI-neutral Interaction structurally complete)
prerequisites: Product/L1 approves actual supported Target variants and selected host/source implementation closure; not a requirement to qualify every OS for every app
coreAndGovernance.doneWhen: Each applicable selected Target has exact Package/source/implementation/host evidence and positive/negative native checks; no universal Windows/Linux/Android triple-platform mandate

coreAndGovernance.theme: Version conformance matrix and final complete native coverage
prerequisites: C1-C3 required applicable Core tests accepted
coreAndGovernance.doneWhen: All applicable Core MUSTs verified, source-linked native positive/negative tests and exact-SHA receipts validated by machine matrix without false promotion

coreAndGovernance.theme: Independent exact-SHA audit and formal L1/L2 Freeze decision
coreAndGovernance.doneWhen: Fresh independent review and repairs bound to latest SHA, Product/L1/L2 decisions explicitly recorded; no automatic merge, freeze or publication

optionalProfiles.theme: Bounded Harness/LLM selection, budget, UNKNOWN, fallback
Experience holdout verification and local data-only evolution slot atomic pin/revoke
Server Promotion, new AOT, privacy/scope and activation

estimates.conditions: Estimate assumes multi-requirement integrated rounds, owner promptly resolves target/scope decisions, independent semantic reviewer can qualify bounded SAP; blockers or P1 failures can add rounds.

blockers.requires: DKE or original source owner independent semantic authority, no synthetic approval
Product/L1 targeted supported variants; Node major not semantic gate
